Dr Daft's Playground

Playgrounds are everywhere, if you are willing to look for them.

Welcome! This is a personal space where I explore and learn by building small, self-contained projects. Each project below is organized into its own folder and is accessible via Github Pages. For information on how I did this, you can read this blog post.
